newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo naphtha price remains firm amid brisk demand.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo naphtha price remains firm amid brisk demand.

text.p: Naphtha prices remained at high levels on Monday despite crude price losses on the ACCESS after-hours trading system, as the supply and demand balance for January continued to be tight, traders said.
First-half February open-spec naphtha was notionally assessed at $247.50/250.00, up slightly from late Friday's $247.00/249.00.
Second-half February was bid at $243.00, while offers were indicated at $244.50. A second-half cargo was sold to a Japanese trading house at $244.25 on Friday.
